FunctionList Update #1 - normalize functionList.xml

- Updated file header and `associationMap`-header.
- Changed order of associations and parsers to follow ascending 'langID' numerical values.
- Removed `displayMode` attributes (are not used).
- Make functionList.xml XML compliant.
- Put set of characters in same order in all character groups.
- Correct `)/` to `/)` in `commentExpr`-attribute.
- Add pattern modifier to multi-line comment expression.
- Add pattern modifier to single-line comment expression.
- When applicable remove outer most parentheses of `commentExpr`-attribute.
- As an underscore is part of character class `\w` (equals group `[A-Za-z0-9_]`) remove the underscore when both are used in the same group.
- Replace the `A-Za-z0-9_` set in a group with character class `\w` as they are equal.
- No need to put one character class in a group e.g. change `[\w]` to `\w`.
- Replace space character with its hexdecimal representation i.e. \x20.
- Corrected Python parser i.e. renamed `funcNameExpr` to `nameExpr` in function-parser part.
- Changed use of L_JS (19) to L_JAVASCRIPT (58).

interactive.title:
fix(search,macro,edit): restore Find/Replace shortcuts and implement Macro/Run and Multi-select

- Search: Search menu Find.../Replace... pointed to nonexistent openFindBar:/openReplaceBar: — now showFind:/showReplace: with ⌘F/⌥⌘F; showFind/showReplace now auto-populate from selection, select-all text, and expose openFindBar/openReplaceBar aliases
- Macro (#1): Add Macro menu (Start/Stop Recording, Playback, Save Macro, Run Multiple Times) and Run menu (Run..., Validate shortcuts.xml); wire SCI_STARTRECORD/STOPRECORD, handle SCN_MACRORECORD to record MacroStep (textParam for string messages), update status REC counter, playback with UNDO grouping, JSON save to ~/Library/Application Support/Notepad++/macros, Run variable expansion ($(FULL_CURRENT_PATH) etc.) via /bin/zsh and output capture
- Multi-select (#4): Add Edit → Multi-select All/Next (4 variants each by SCFIND flags) plus Undo Latest / Skip Current & Go Next; helpers currentMultiSelectPatternForFlags, multiSelectAllWithFlags using SCI_SEARCHINTARGET + SCI_CLEAR/ADDSELECTION with scroll, multiSelectNextWithFlags with wrap, undo/skip via selection reconstruction
- Preserves vscode/ exclusion
